scope: First reduce sampler preparation storage without changing the law or particle stream, then run a bounded real-current-state runtime/support pilot. No fitting, native trajectories, calibration, source-transfer or control experiment.
basis: The frozen15-case synthetic comparison passed with no positive-support misses, NLL RMSE0.036166 at1024, and approximately halved error relative to256. Real large frames, full5-10 actor LC accuracy and arbitrary parameter ranges are not yet admitted. Sampler.configurations currently retains a full kernel/context per goal tuple, which must be removed before a large-frame pilot.

fixed.law: Same geometry-selected full J, responsive complete background, frozen priors, residual/permission nodes, canonical current-goal features, LC order and observation kernel. No actor/branch pruning or physical-rule change.
fixed.original9: Use the exact ordered references from tsc_packet_conditional_domain_20261110/cohort.json. Their fixed-zero exact LC/speed/joint probabilities are already in tsc_packet_conditional_panel_20261110/evaluation_summary.json; do not re-enumerate them.
fixed.additional6: For each required J size5,6,7,8,9,10, take the first exact current case in lexicographic(seed,time_sec,packet_id) order from the completed census server-only case records. Append in increasing J-size order. Read no native label or likelihood during selection.
fixed.cohort: Exactly15 distinct seed/time/focal references. Freeze labels-free cohort and unchanged required participant sets/current bounds before probability queries. Original9 sumJ22, additional6 sumJ45, total67. No replacements if an example fails.
fixed.particle_seed: 20261111+100000*case_index; case_index0..14 in the frozen cohort order. One1024-particle pool per case, same proposal and RNG consumption as the frozen sampler.
parameter_probes: The same fixed theta[b,j]=0.1*(-1)^(b+j)/(j+1) point. Both use one particle pool; no coefficient search.

memory_and_preparation_gate: Keep the current particles.py as a frozen reference. In the new stage, memoize only numeric canonical phi and permission applicability per current-goal tuple. Retain one base kernel and at most one live current-goal physical view/context, not a full kernel copy for every tuple. No LRU/eviction framework is needed.

Canonical current features use the full current packet set and installed goals/connections; current _context does not require prepare_receiving_context or its full-frame nominal-proposal sweep. Use a lightweight goal view and build_context for physics, and direct canonical feature evaluation. Preserve exact current-goal context for every actor.

Before any real response, compare small same-seed old/new pools across the frozen synthetic fixtures, including5/10-actor layouts and a prepare_zero_kernel state without prepared _mean_alignment_context/_conditional_* attributes. Compare features, factors, masks, focal outcomes, probabilities and gradients at both fixed probes.

Check input/RNG isolation, no kernel/context objects in numeric memo values, bounded live physical views, and0 MotionResolver constructions/resolution during feature-only evaluation. Log each distinct-goal feature evaluation and its cost separately from particle full forwards. No full synthetic32x1024 panel rerun.
real_pilot: Use only existing static/history laws, observed current frames and aligned signal actions. All arrays/frames/particle caches stay on the server; do not modify any shared runtime, Thesis or production controller.

Select and freeze the15-case cohort by current census fields. Register full required sets at cap10 and their priors before responses. If a required set/initialization differs from its saved current census, stop and report rather than changing the cohort.

Only after cohort freeze, recover available original head labels from the saved reservoir for these exact tuples. For original9 also reuse the already saved native speed/class labels and exact fixed-zero likelihoods. Do not form fresh native simulation branches or relabel the reservoir.

Build exactly one1024-particle pool per state. Reuse first256 and all1024 at both fixed theta points. All head readouts share the same finite SNIS weights and correct normalizer gradients; no physical call during parameter/readout reuse.

On original9 theta0, compare approximate LC probabilities, speed likelihoods and class-speed likelihoods with saved exact values without another reference response. For the new6 and real nonzero point report finite-pool support, normalization, ESS, runtime and memory; there is no real exact oracle there.

A sampled positive branch body/path/remap failure makes its case unsupported for this pilot: preserve the failure and consumed cost, stop launching new cases, and let already running cases finish. Never drop that branch or replace an example. A missed known-positive original9 observation is a sampling support failure, not evidence of structural impossibility.

Preserve all completed cases and compact per-case receipts, including partial consumed counts. Do not retry another seed, raise the particle budget, fit parameters or launch a rollout after a failure.

budgets.feature_budget_formula: At most1024 distinct goal tuples per case, one canonical phi/nominal-proposal evaluation per selected actor:1024*(22+45)=68608. No full-frame nominal sweep per tuple.

readouts: Memory-only implementation equivalence and separate feature-preparation versus particle-resolver counts.
All15 current-state dispositions and full participant IDs, no case omitted.
Original9 saved-exact probability/NLL differences at theta0 for N256/1024; all support failures retained.

All cases: common-law normalization/joint consistency, applicable observed-head support, proposal/survivor/posterior ESS and max weight at both probes, feature and particle wall time, worker-process peak RSS.
decision: Judge real cost and local approximation readiness only. A successful pilot would not establish full160000 computability, unseen-branch domain validity, independent prediction, cross-city contribution or control improvement. No training target is replaced by these15 selected diagnostic states.
after: Stop after the15-state pilot or a gate/domain/budget HOLD. Any fitting or larger sample design needs a separate frozen cohort, objective and computation budget.
storage: Keep full frames, arrays and particle payloads server-side. Pull only small summary JSON and logs; no checkpoint/model download or new datasets.
